In case Buyer has selected Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises clause in the bid, the same will get precedence over this clause. 8. Swachh Bharat Mission(SBM) Maintenance of Fire Extinguisher The shift operators shall 1.Maintain the record of checking and certification of all fire extinguishers. 2.Maintain the fire extinguisher at the proper location installed for the purpose. 3.Organise training to aware the use of fire extinguisher. 4.Organise a mock drill for fire extinguisher. 5.Replace/Refill the chemicals 15 days before expiry date
